prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: a blender exploding to life with green leaves, pineapple chunks and ginger, vortex spinning in macro. The camera follows the vivid green pour into a glass, then slides to a pan where zucchini noodles twist and toss with garlic. Money shot: a bright, glowing bowl assembled — the zucchini nest topped with grilled chicken strips and seeds, lime squeezed over it, droplets flying backlit. Final beat: glass and bowl together on the counter, morning-fresh. Warm clean light, vibrant greens against dark wood, film grain. Dominant sound: the blender roar, then the citrus squeeze. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
